items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: when he played the quadrille with Sonny Henry

ctx.x: Ricca band. Willie Paggio had the Ricca band. And I used to play with the jazz band with Willie Paggio too. Where were you playing with Willie? Well we used to play all down in Beerus and Delco Islands and Mason Conventions and Shreveport. We used to go all over with him just before Willie died. I was playing with him then. We used to go all over and play. Did you play that quadrille with Willie ever,
you know, when he played the quadrille with Sonny Henry and those guys? Well I have played quadrilles

down there for the Creole Fiesta. Yeah, that's what I was. Down at the Autocrats. Yeah. Yeah. I think Willie played it at the... Mm-hmm. I used to, all of those fellas, I played with them, uh, usually the best bands, you know, Sam Dutre and all that bunch. We played together. And two times, you know, on and off. You know how this work is, whoever gets a gig sometimes, you know,
